_about: WORDS 11/2 (Paolo, ask line 256: eighth-grade reading). What each of the eight stats the crew screen prints means, one plain line each, in the screen's own stat words (engine/bohemia_stats.js NAME). draft:true. NOT WIRED YET: the crew screen's stat tap says the name and the number; the hook that adds this line is UI's (the roster screen's stat click), owed.

rows.hp: How much damage you can take before you go down.
rows.fatigue: How much you can do before you are worn out. Every step and swing uses some.
rows.ranged_skill: Your chance to hit from far away: guns, bows, bottles.
rows.melee_skill: Your chance to hit up close.
rows.ranged_defense: How hard you are to hit from far away.
rows.melee_defense: How hard you are to hit up close.
rows.resolve: Your nerve. Low resolve and you panic or run.
rows.initiative: How early you move each round. Heavy gear and being tired lower it.
